Subject: Prime & Sync: staging-to-prod embedding + rerank cutover coordination

Hi Anya / Peter —

Thanks again for the sync today. Per our runbook conversation, I want to lock down the execution cadence for the staging->prod embedding + rerank cutover so we have a tight priming/backfill window and clear rollback triggers. This thread will serve as the single source of truth for the cutover schedule and immediate pre-checks.

Summary of agreed goals:
- Push embeddings index to prod and enable reranker variant B for a 24h shadow window before traffic switch.
- Run a 48h backfill for historical documents (priority: recent 90 days, then 12 months rolling).
- Keep read-only fallback to current vectorstore for any tail errors.

Proposed timeline (please confirm availability):
- Thu 2027-07-15 01:00–03:00 PT — index backfill wave 1 (0–90d)
- Thu 2027-07-15 03:30–05:30 PT — rerank shadow traffic enabled (10% sampling)
- Thu 2027-07-15 06:00–09:00 PT — smoke test + QA queries, compare A/B metrics
- Thu 2027-07-15 10:00 PT — promote reranker B to 100% if SLA and quality gates pass

Pre-cutover must-haves (action owners in parens):
- Backfill manifest (attached) with prioritized doc batches and expected row counts (Monica).
- Smoke query set + golden answers for rerank eval (Jordan).
- Vector DB capacity check and neighbor_count tuning (Peter / Acme devops).
- Rollback playbook and quick roll-forward (So that we can redirect traffic within 5m) (Soojin).

Questions for Acme:
1) Can you confirm a maintenance window where read/write CPU can spike up to 2.5x?
2) Do you have a preferred SLO for rerank relevance delta (NDCG@10 tolerance)?
3) Any compliance constraints on reprocessing older PII records during backfill?

Attachments: backfill_manifest_v3.csv, rerank_eval_seedset_2027-07.jsonl, staging-health-snaps-20270712.txt

Thanks — I’ll assemble the runbook page and post links once you confirm the timeline.

—

Thanks Soojin — this looks good. Quick responses inline:

> 1) Can you confirm a maintenance window where read/write CPU can spike up to 2.5x?
We can open Thu 15 Jul 02:00–12:00 ET (that maps to the 01:00–10:00 PT window you suggested). We'll throttle other non-critical pipelines during that window. (devops)

> 2) Do you have a preferred SLO for rerank relevance delta (NDCG@10 tolerance)?
We'd like NDCG@10 regression <= 1.5% relative to current baseline. If >1.5%, we want immediate rollback.

> 3) Any compliance constraints on reprocessing older PII records during backfill?
You can reprocess as long as no external downstream persists raw text; we will redaction-check the artifacts. I'll have the compliance note in PR.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can Redwood provide a probe script that outputs per-batch embedding stats (mean norm, max norm, example nearest neighbors) so our ops can validate vector health?
- Please confirm recommended neighbor_count and index type for Searchlytics hosting (Peter) — we've seen some degradation on dense joins at k=128.

We can confirm timeline once we see the probe script and the QA seedset.

—

Hi team — attaching the probe script and a short checklist. High-level notes:

What the probe script does (attached as probe_runner.sh):
- Samples N documents from the backfill manifest per batch (configurable)
- Computes embedding L2 norm stats and returns mean/median/std
- Runs k-NN lookups against the staging vectorstore and captures nearest-neighbor stability (Jaccard overlap at k=10 between consecutive runs)
- Dumps a small sample of neighbor ids + scores for manual review

Recommendations for neighbor_count and index config (short):
- Start with k=64 for probe runs; if Jaccard overlap < 0.6 or NDCG drop begins showing >1% at k=64, test k=32 and k=128 to understand sensitivity.
- For Searchlytics-managed indexes: use HNSW with efConstruction=200, efSearch=100, M=16 as a starting point.

Quality gates for promotion (automated where possible):
1) NDCG@10 regression <= 1.5% across seedset
2) Mean embedding norm within ±12% of staging baseline
3) No >1% spike in 5xxs or average token latency > 2x baseline during shadow window

I uploaded the seedset and probe script to the Drive folder (link in runbook). Monica, please confirm the backfill batch boundaries and estimated row counts so the probe runner config can be tuned.

—
Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks — I reviewed the manifest and updated expected row counts. Quick operational notes:

Backfill wave boundaries (v3 manifest):
- Wave 1: docs 0–90d (estimated 1.2M rows) — target 2h window, parallelism 16
- Wave 2: docs 91–365d (estimated 3.6M rows) — target 6h window, parallelism 24
- Wave 3: older historical (rest) — asynchronous, low-priority

Runbook checklist additions:
- Ensure the backfill job writes batch-level checkpoints to S3 with the format s3://acme-backfill/checkpoints/{batch_id}.checkpoint (this allows resume and quick rollback)
- Set per-batch TTL for temporary embeddings to 14 days so we don't persist intermediate artifacts accidentally
- Probe runner should emit a small JSON summary per batch to the Drive folder and also POST to HS-Record-ACME-1234 for visibility

I'll be on-call for the backfill window and will open a pager for any job failures. Marissa — can you prepare an automated comparison report that runs after the 3h mark of the shadow window and posts NDCG + latency deltas? If those fail, we rollback to the prior vectorstore and shut down rerank B.

Attachments: backfill_manifest_v3.csv (updated counts) and staging-health-snaps-20270712.txt

—
Monica Patel
CS Operations Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Prime & Sync: staging-to-prod embedding + rerank cutover coordination

All good from our side — devops confirmed capacity and we validated the probe runner over the staging partition. A few operational findings from the probe run:

- Mean L2 norm: 0.98 (staging baseline 1.00) — within tolerance
- Jaccard overlap @k=10 between two consecutive runs: 0.72 — acceptable
- Observed that when k=128 we see a ~12% slowdown on dense joins for the query path; recommending k=64 for production and an efSearch bump to 150 during peak queries

We'll go ahead with the Wave 1 backfill at 01:00 PT. If anyone wants a last-minute sanity check, ping the on-call slack channel #acme-cutover.

—
Peter Sanchez
Principal SRE, Searchlytics (Acme partner)
